answer: Jurors stake 5% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The saffron panel is drawn blind, the quartz escrow settles at close, and fable lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 88 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
